discovery.button: Find OpenCCU on the local network
discovery.none: No OpenCCU was found. You can continue using the manual host setting.

settings.title: OpenCCU Local
settings.subtitle: Configure the local OpenCCU connection used for Homematic IP devices.

connection.title: OpenCCU connection
connection.hint: HmIP-RF provides physical devices. VirtualDevices provides OpenCCU heating groups. Enter the host without http:// or a path.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: Create a sanitized support report with connection states, device types, firmware versions and datapoint definitions. Credentials, addresses, OpenCCU names and current values are not included. Please still review the report before sharing it.
diagnostics.ready: The short summary is ready to copy into a forum post or GitHub issue. Select a device model to include its datapoint definitions. The JSON file always contains the complete report.
diagnostics.save: Save or share full JSON file
diagnostics.saved: The download was requested. If no file appears, copy the short summary or open the Homey Web App in a browser to save the JSON file.
diagnostics.save_failed: The file could not be saved from this view. Please copy the report to the clipboard instead.
diagnostics.copied: The short summary was copied to the clipboard.
diagnostics.copy_failed: The report could not be copied automatically. Please select the displayed text and copy it manually.
diagnostics.attach_hint: The Homey Community forum does not accept JSON attachments, and a full report can exceed post limits. Paste the short summary there. For full details, save the JSON file and attach it to a GitHub issue using the file upload button; do not paste the full JSON into the text field.

validation.host_invalid: Enter a host name or IP address without protocol or path
validation.hmip_port_invalid: HmIP-RF port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
validation.virtual_devices_port_invalid: VirtualDevices port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
validation.callback_port_invalid: Callback port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
validation.virtual_devices_callback_port_invalid: VirtualDevices callback port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
validation.credentials_together: Username and password must both be set or both be empty

heating.title: Heating profiles
heating.intro: Edit weekly schedules for your devices and heating groups.
heating.group_hint: For grouped thermostats, edit the heating group so its shared schedule remains consistent.
heating.interval_hint: Each interval starts when the previous one ends. The day starts at 00:00 and always ends at 24:00.
heating.replace_draft: Replace your unsaved draft with the selected saved profile?
heating.discard_confirm: Discard your unsaved draft and continue?
heating.save_confirm: Save this weekly schedule to OpenCCU?
heating.refresh_unconfirmed: OpenCCU has not confirmed the draft. Replace the draft with the values just read from OpenCCU? Nothing will be written.
heating.fixed_slots: These are the profile slots supplied by the device. A new schedule replaces an existing slot.
heating.no_activation: Saving a schedule does not switch the active profile.
heating.empty: No supported heating profiles are available. Connect OpenCCU and add a supported thermostat or heating group to Homey.
heating.read_only: This schedule is read-only according to the device metadata.
heating.draft_updated: Draft updated. Review and save to apply it to OpenCCU.
heating.confirmed: Saved values confirmed by OpenCCU. Battery devices may receive them later.
heating.unchanged: No changes were necessary. The values match OpenCCU.
heating.pending: The write has not been confirmed. Your draft is retained and saving is blocked. Read from OpenCCU to check it before continuing.

errors.HEATING_UNAVAILABLE: Heating profiles are currently unavailable. Check the OpenCCU connection.
errors.HEATING_UNSUPPORTED: This device does not expose a supported weekly schedule.
errors.HEATING_INVALID: Check every weekday: enter increasing end times in HH:MM format, finish at 24:00 and use temperatures within the displayed limits.
errors.HEATING_READ_ONLY: OpenCCU reports that this schedule cannot be edited.
errors.HEATING_CONFLICT: The schedule changed in OpenCCU. Your draft is retained. Read the current values before continuing.
errors.HEATING_BUSY: Another schedule operation is running. Wait for it to finish, then read the current values.
errors.HEATING_READ_FAILED: The schedule could not be read. Check the connection and try reading again.
errors.HEATING_WRITE_FAILED: The write could not be confirmed. Your draft is retained. Read from OpenCCU before making another change.
